column1: # Charon fleet roadmap — canonical source of truth for status/handoff reports.
# One row per item. Tab-separated. Fields: project<TAB>id<TAB>status<TAB>phase<TAB>name<TAB>goal
# status: done in-review building queued designed parked not-started
# goal:   plain-language outcome, <= 6 words, no status words (the dot carries status).
# Program numbers are assigned by project order-of-first-appearance; rows render in input order.
# Edit this file to move an item; fleet/report.sh re-renders the canonical format from it.
